responsibility: Declares the analyzer’s immutable symbolic-value class hierarchy used throughout region_model, constraints, and checker state. It defines the svalue_kind taxonomy, base svalue API for type, dumping, merging, liveness, bit extraction, and visitor traversal, and the concrete subclasses representing pointers to regions, constants, unknown/poisoned/initial values, symbolic operations, repeated and sliced values, merge inhibitors, widening and compound values, conjured call results, deterministic asm outputs, and cached const-function results.
same_name_distinction: Defines the symbolic-value type system itself—the svalue_kind enum, base API, subclass hierarchy, and uniquing key structures that svalue.cc then gives concrete behavior for via merging, folding, liveness, dumping, and visitation methods.
